name: Notchex — a working notch for GNOME
description: A macOS-style desktop for GNOME 46+. A MacBook-style notch replaces the top-bar clock: live media with album art and audio-reactive bars, transient events for track changes, volume, brightness, battery, Bluetooth, notifications and upcoming meetings, and an expandable hub with system monitor, Google Calendar & Tasks via GOA, weather, Pomodoro, notes, Claude Code usage and quick controls. Also ships a magnifying Dock, Spotlight search in the notch, frosted-glass top bar and menus, a Control Center look for Quick Settings, auto-hiding top bar, three-finger zoom gestures and optional traffic-light window buttons.
